verdict.rationale: Greptile is itself a built-in AI agent: you can hand it pull-request review, unit-test generation, PR diagrams and sandboxed runtime testing (TREX), and community users report asking it codebase questions and getting useful answers. However, the product does not do fix and implementation work itself. Its 'Fix with your Agent' and 'Fix All' buttons send those tasks to external agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or Devin. Missing for 10: an in-product assistant that carries out fixes or general tasks, and independent hands-on corroboration of task delegation beyond review and Q&A.
